title: By hook or by crook: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 71
content:
## By hook or by crook

**Word Power 71 · English idioms**

### Meaning

By any method possible, even a dishonest one.

### Usage

1. I want to get this licence by hook or by crook.
2. Today's politician is interested in nothing but gaining power, be it by hook or by crook.

### How to use it

By hook or by crook means by any means available, possibly including dishonest ones. Because of that implication, it can sound disapproving. Use an expression such as through honest effort when you want to avoid that suggestion.

### Another example

The fictional villain wanted to obtain the document by hook or by crook.

### Check your understanding

Does this phrase always promise that only honest methods will be used?

### Suggested answer

No. The phrase may include dishonest methods. Understanding it does not mean approving of the behaviour it describes.
